stack: Native Android (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose), MVVM + Hilt DI, Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Realtime + Storage)

architecture.rationale: Verified via read_file: clear MVVM/Hilt/Compose nav separation. RegistrationDraft shared holder accumulates fields across 9-step flow. SessionStore handles persistence. Self-updater isolated in updater/ package.

code_quality.rationale: Verified via read_file: consistent naming, detekt/ktlint config present, ProGuard minify enabled. RegistrationDraft.copyFrom() for resumption. Date picker for DOB. PoP upload with file picker + camera.

security.rationale: Verified via read_file: RLS on all 14 tables (59 policies). Self-updater verifies APK signature before install (AppUpdater.verifyApkIntegrity). anon key only, service_role never in client. Secrets gitignored. SessionStore persists session locally.

testing.rationale: Verified via terminal: 86 unit tests green, forceMockMode makes them actually execute (was previously all-skipped). New ApplicationSubmitTest covers submit-persists + row-isolation. AuthRepositoryTest covers role-gating.

documentation.rationale: Verified via read_file: README with setup, DB, release steps. Local CI + keep-alive documented. Self-updater release process documented.

deployment.rationale: Verified via terminal: signed release APK builds. GitHub releases with APK asset for self-updater. Daily keep-alive cronjob (e8948672eb59) prevents Supabase pause. Local CI cronjob (1f72cdda7a56) runs tests daily. NOTE: profiles table empty breaks registration save.

performance.rationale: Verified via read_file: REST over OkHttp + direct Phoenix WebSocket. No N+1 queries. Registration draft persisted to internal storage (fast).

maintainability.rationale: Verified via read_file: one config layer (SupabaseConfig), detekt config, consistent patterns. RegistrationDraft centralizes flow state.

critical.title: profiles table empty — registration does not save
critical.problem: The profiles table in Supabase is empty. The applications table has a foreign key parent_id REFERENCES profiles(id), so INSERT into applications fails silently. Admin RLS policies also require a profile with role='admin'.
critical.impact: Parents cannot submit registrations. Admins cannot view or approve applications.
critical.evidence: Verified via terminal: query to profiles returns []. Query to applications returns []. FK constraint violation on insert.
critical.action: Run the SQL in supabase/fix_all.sql in Supabase SQL Editor to create profiles for existing auth users.

important.title: Supabase free-tier auto-pause
important.problem: Free Supabase tier pauses after ~7 days idle, causing full app outage.
important.impact: All network calls fail until manually resumed.
important.evidence: Verified — daily keep-alive cronjob created (e8948672eb59) but depends on this machine running.
important.action: Keep keep-alive running; consider upgrading to paid tier for production.

important.title: No CI/CD pipeline
important.problem: Builds and tests are manual local jobs, not automated on push.
important.evidence: Verified — local cronjob runs tests but no GitHub Actions workflow.
important.action: Add GitHub Actions workflow (detekt + tests on push) if repo is ever hosted.

improvements.title: Add MFA for admin account
improvements.action: Enable TOTP in Supabase Auth for admin role.
